saichania:eswiki:4.title: Saichania chulsanensis (Tamaño, constitución y rasgos distintivos)

facts.statement: Saichania is a genus of herbivorous ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived in Mongolia and China during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Saichania (Mongolian meaning "beautiful one") is a genus of herbivorous ankylosaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period of Mongolia and China.

facts.statement: The first fossils of Saichania were discovered in the early 1970s within the Baruungoyot Formation.
facts.quote: The first fossils of Saichania were found in the early 1970s in the Baruungoyot Formation.

facts.statement: The type species Saichania chulsanensis was formally named in 1977.
facts.quote: In 1977, the type species Saichania chulsanensis was named.

facts.statement: A Polish-Mongolian expedition discovered Saichania fossils in the Gobi Desert near Chulsan in 1970 and 1971.
facts.quote: In 1970 and 1971 a Polish-Mongolian expedition found ankylosaurian fossils in the Gobi Desert near Chulsan, or Khulsan.

facts.statement: The genus name Saichania comes from the Mongolian word for 'beautiful', referencing the excellent preservation of the type specimen.
facts.quote: The generic name originates from the Mongolian сайхан (saikhan), meaning "beautiful", referring to the pristine state of preservation of the type specimen.

facts.statement: Saichania was more robust than other ankylosaurids, reaching lengths of 5 to 7 meters and weighing between 1.4 and 2.0 metric tons.
facts.quote: Saichania is more robustly built than other members of the Ankylosauridae, measuring 5 - 7 m in length and 1.4 - 2.0 MT in body mass.

facts.statement: Saichania possessed fused or firmly connected neck vertebrae, shoulder girdle, and ribs.
facts.quote: Neck vertebrae, the shoulder girdle, and ribs were fused or firmly connected.

facts.statement: Saichania had a flat, low-slung body supported by four short legs.
facts.quote: Its body is flat and low-slung, standing on four short legs.

facts.statement: Saichania had very powerful forelimbs.
facts.quote: The forelimbs were very powerful.

facts.statement: Saichania's head was protected by bulbous armor tiles.
facts.quote: The head was protected by bulbous armour tiles.

facts.statement: Saichania used a tail club to defend itself against predators such as Tarbosaurus.
facts.quote: It could defend itself against predators like Tarbosaurus with a tail club.

facts.statement: Keeled osteoderms were present on Saichania's torso.
facts.quote: On the torso, keeled osteoderms were present.

facts.statement: Saichania used a horny beak to bite off plants in its desert habitat and processed them in a wide hindgut.
facts.quote: Saichania bit off plants in its desert habitat with a horny beak and processed them in its wide hindgut.

facts.statement: Saichania is classified as a medium-sized ankylosaur with a length of 5 to 7 meters and a mass of 1.4 to 2.0 metric tons.
facts.quote: Saichania was a medium-sized ankylosaur, measuring 5 - 7 m in length and 1.4 - 2.0 MT in body mass.

facts.statement: Saichania shared the typical ankylosaurid build of being low-slung, broad, heavily armored, and having short forelimbs.
facts.quote: Saichania shared the general ankylosaurid build, being a low-slung, broad, heavily armoured dinosaur, with short forelimbs.

facts.statement: The osteoderms on Saichania's skull are bulbous.
facts.quote: The osteoderms on the skull are bulbous.

facts.statement: The first and second neck vertebrae of Saichania are fused into a single element known as a syncervical.
facts.quote: The first and second neck vertebrae are fused into a single element, a syncervical.

facts.statement: The upper side of Saichania's humerus is very broad, equaling 70% of the bone's total length.
facts.quote: The upper side of the humerus is very broad, equalling 70% of the total length of the bone.

facts.statement: Saichania's rib shafts were expanded by intercostal ossifications, where the cartilage connecting the ribs turned into bone sheets.
facts.quote: The rib shafts are expanded by intercostal ossifications, the cartilage connecting the ribs having been turned into bone sheets.

facts.statement: Saichania's cervical halfrings had underlying continuous bands of bone, with borders covered by extra armor plates that hid the connections from view.
facts.quote: The cervical halfrings, protecting the neck, have each an underlying continuous band of bone and the borders between the segments of these rings are covered by extra armour plates entirely hiding these connections from view.

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Saichania is broad, measuring 455 millimeters in length and 480 millimeters in width.
facts.quote: The skull of Saichania is broad, 455 millimetres long and 480 millimetres wide with the holotype.

facts.statement: The top of Saichania's snout is covered with strongly convex osteoderms.
facts.quote: The top of the snout is covered with strongly convex osteoderms.

facts.statement: Saichania possessed broad, pyramid-shaped squamosal horns on the rear corners of its skull, unlike the narrow horns of Tarchia.
facts.quote: The pyramid-shaped squamosal horns on the rear skull corners are broad, not narrow as with Tarchia.

facts.statement: Large triangular quadratojugal horns were present on Saichania's cheeks.
facts.quote: On the cheek, large triangular quadratojugal horns are present.

facts.statement: Saichania's skull contained very complex air passages.
facts.quote: The skull had very complex air passages.

facts.statement: Saichania possessed a scroll-like turbinate bone structure that likely helped condense and preserve exhaled moisture, similar to warm-blooded animals.
facts.quote: This latter was a scroll-like structure, a turbinate bone serving with warm-blooded animals to condense and preserve exhaled moisture.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest Saichania's complex air passages may have allowed it to cool inhaled air and limit water loss.
facts.quote: The air passages may have allowed the animal to cool the air that it breathed and limit water loss.

facts.statement: Saichania's unusually strongly ossified hard palate likely allowed it to eat tough plants.
facts.quote: The hard palate allowed it to eat tough plants.

facts.statement: The anatomical features of Saichania suggest it lived in a hot, arid environment.
facts.quote: All this suggested that it lived in a hot, arid, environment.

facts.statement: Some evidence suggests Saichania may have possessed a salt gland near its nostrils to aid survival in a desert habitat.
facts.quote: There is even some evidence that the animal may have possessed a salt gland next to its nostrils, which would have further aided it in a desert habitat.

facts.statement: Saichania had small, leaf-shaped teeth.
facts.quote: The teeth were small and leaf-shaped.

facts.statement: The holotype of Saichania had twenty-two teeth in each maxilla, with seventeen in the right lower jaw and sixteen in the left lower jaw.
facts.quote: There are twenty-two of them in each maxilla, seventeen in the right and sixteen in the left lower jaw of the holotype.

facts.statement: A large hyoid bone apparatus was discovered in 1977, which was the most complete ever found for any dinosaur at that time.
facts.quote: A large hyoid bone apparatus was found, in 1977 the most complete discovered for any dinosaur.

facts.statement: In 2014, Victoria Megan Arbour debated that a previously described juvenile specimen was misleadingly reconstructed with a skull cast from the holotype and likely belonged to a different ankylosaur, possibly Pinacosaurus.
facts.quote: However, in 2014 Victoria Megan Arbour concluded that the describers had been misled by the skeleton having been completed with a skull cast of GI SPS 100/151, and that the remainder of the fossil belonged to some other ankylosaur, possibly Pinacosaurus.

facts.statement: The referral of specimen PIN 3142/250 to Saichania was contested by Penkalski and Tumanova, who argued it belonged to a new species of Tarchia, T. teresae.
facts.quote: The referral of PIN 3142/250 to Saichania was contested by Penkalski & Tumanova who considered this specimen to be referable to a new species of Tarchia, T. teresae.

facts.statement: Tianzhenosaurus and Shanxia have been proposed as potential synonyms of Saichania.
facts.quote: synonyms: *Tianzhenosaurus? Pang & Cheng, 1998 Shanxia? Barrett et al., 1998

facts.statement: The atlas and axis vertebrae of Saichania are fused together.
facts.quote: The front neck vertebrae, the atlas and axis, are grown together.

facts.statement: Saichania possessed a longer and more flexible neck than previously assumed, supported by thick intervertebral discs.
facts.quote: The cervical vertebrae have very long joint processes, zygapophyses, showing that thick intervertebral discs must have been present and that the neck was longer and more flexible than is often assumed.

facts.statement: The shoulder girdle of Saichania was immobilized relative to the spine due to fusions between ribs and vertebrae.
facts.quote: The short rib and the diapophysis of the first dorsal vertebra are fused with the coracoid, immobilising the entire shoulder girdle relative to the vertebral column.

facts.statement: Saichania had a fully ossified sternal plate that was split in front and forked at the rear.
facts.quote: The breast bones are fully ossified and connect to form a sternal plate that is split in front and broadly forked at the rear.

facts.statement: In 1977, Saichania was known to have the shortest metacarpus of any Asian ankylosaur.
facts.quote: The metacarpus is short, in 1977 it was the shortest of any Asian ankylosaur known.

facts.statement: Saichania's neck was protected by two rings of six rectangular osteoderms each.
facts.quote: The neck is protected by two cervical halfrings, each made of six rectangular segments positioned next to each other: two at the top, two at the upper sides and two at the lower sides.

facts.statement: A larger central osteoderm formed a rosette pattern between the upper and lower side segments of the neck armor.
facts.quote: Between the upper and lower side segment a larger central osteoderm is present, forming a rosette.

facts.statement: Saichania had a central row of symmetrical conical osteoderms running down its back.
facts.quote: A central row of symmetrical conical osteoderms is positioned on the back.

facts.statement: Osteoderms were present on the underside of Saichania's breast.
facts.quote: On the underside of the breast, osteoderms are present also.

facts.statement: Maryańska classified Saichania as a member of the Ankylosauridae family, noting its unique nasal cavity structure.
facts.quote: Maryańska classified Saichania as a member of the Ankylosauridae, related to Pinacosaurus and observed that these two dinosaurs differ from all others in the structure of their nasal cavities.

facts.statement: Saichania lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Cretácico Superior

facts.statement: Saichania lived between 75 and 70 million years ago in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: Saichania chulsanensis es la única especie conocida del género extinto Saichania (mon. “hermoso”) de dinosaurio tireofóro anquilosáurido, que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 75 a 70 millones de años, en el Campaniense y Maastrichtiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Saichania measured over 5 meters in length and weighed over two tonnes.
facts.quote: Saichania medía más de 5 metros de largo y pesaba más de dos toneladas.

facts.statement: Saichania had a flat, low body supported by four short legs.
facts.quote: Su cuerpo era plano y bajo, de pie sobre cuatro patas cortas.

facts.statement: Saichania ate plants in its desert habitat using a horny beak and processed them in a wide intestine.
facts.quote: Saichania comía plantas en su hábitat desértico con un pico córneo y las procesó en su ancho intestino grueso.

facts.statement: Saichania is more closely related to Asian ankylosaurs like Pinacosaurus and Tarchia than to North American ones like Ankylosaurus.
facts.quote: Saichania está más emparentado con Pinacosaurus, Tarchia y Talarurus de Asia que con los norteamericanos Ankylosaurus o Euoplocephalus, aunque todos son parte de la familia Ankylosauridae.

facts.statement: Saichania could reach 7 meters in length and 2.2 meters in height, with an estimated weight of 2 tonnes.
facts.quote: Saichania era un poderoso dinosaurio acorazado que llegó a medir 7 metros de largo y 2,2 de alto, con un peso estimado de 2 toneladas.

facts.statement: Saichania was protected by armor covering both its upper and ventral sides, a feature unique to this dinosaur.
facts.quote: Estaba fuertemente protegido por una armadura que cubría no solo su parte superior, como es usual, sino también la ventral, cosa solo conocida en este dinosaurio.

facts.statement: Saichania had a large, oval nose separated by a horizontal septum, possibly used to filter, humidify, and heat air.
facts.quote: La nariz externa, grande y ovalada, estaba separada por un septum horizontal que le daba una trayectoria curva, característica compartida con el Pinacosaurus, pudiéndole servir para filtrar, humidificar y calentar el aire.

facts.statement: Saichania had a strong bony palate, likely used to breathe conditioned air and eat tough plants in an arid environment.
facts.quote: El cráneo estaba sólidamente construido, con un paladar óseo muy fuerte, cosa muy poco vista en otros animales, este le serviría para acondicionar el aire que respiraba y poder comer plantas muy duras, lo que indicaría que vivo en un ambiente árido y caluroso.

facts.statement: Evidence suggests Saichania had a salt gland in its nose, common in desert animals.
facts.quote: También existe evidencia que este animal tendría una glándula de sal en la nariz, cosa común en los animales del desierto.

facts.statement: Saichania's armor plates were porous and hollow, making them very light and allowing for agile movement.
facts.quote: Las placas eran de hueso poroso y su interior era hueco, por lo tanto, muy ligero, lo que le permitía moverse con una cierta desenvoltura.

facts.statement: Saichania's tail ended in a bulbous club; while traditionally thought to be a weapon, it may have been highly vascularized to mimic a false head and confuse predators.
facts.quote: Tendones osificados fortalecían su cola que terminaba en una porra bulbosa que tradicionalmente se supuso que fue usada para golpear a sus atacantes; sin embargo, su función original pudo ser distinta ya que era una estructura muy irrigada, simulando una cabeza falsa y así confundir a los depredadores.

facts.statement: The theory that Saichania's tail club mimicked a false head is less scientifically accepted than the traditional weapon hypothesis.
facts.quote: Esta última teoría está menos aceptada que la primera científicamente.

facts.statement: Maryańska estimated the length of Saichania at 7 meters.
facts.quote: Maryańska estimó su longitud en 7 metros.

facts.statement: Other estimates confirmed a maximum length of approximately 6.6 meters.
facts.quote: Otras estimaciones confirmaron aproximadamente esto, indicando una longitud máxima de aproximadamente 6,6 metros de largo.

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Saichania was 5.2 meters long and weighed two tons.
facts.quote: Gregory S. Paul en 2010 dio una estimación más baja de 5,2 metros, con un peso de dos toneladas.

facts.statement: Saichania was a large ankylosaur.
facts.quote: Saichania era un gran anquilosaurio.

facts.statement: Saichania was a wide, low, heavily armored dinosaur with short forelimbs, typical of ankylosaurs.
facts.quote: Saichania compartía la constitución general de anquilosáuridos, siendo un dinosaurio ancho, bajo y fuertemente blindado, con extremidades anteriores cortas.

facts.statement: Its hindquarters were reinforced by ossifications and fusions of the spine, ribs, shoulder girdle, and breast bones.
facts.quote: su grupa está reforzada por osificaciones y fusiones de la columna vertebral, las costillas, la cintura escapular y los huesos del pecho.

facts.statement: The skull osteoderms were bulbous.
facts.quote: Los osteodermos del cráneo son bulbosos.

facts.statement: The first and second neck vertebrae fused into a single element called a synchervical.
facts.quote: La primera y la segunda vértebra del cuello se fusionan en un solo elemento, un sincervical.

facts.statement: The top side of the humerus was very wide, equivalent to 70% of the bone's total length.
facts.quote: El lado superior del húmero es muy ancho, equivalente al 70% de la longitud total del hueso.

facts.statement: The middle cervical rings protecting the neck had a continuous underlying bone band, with additional armor plates covering the segment edges to hide connections.
facts.quote: Los medios anillos cervicales, que protegen el cuello, tienen cada uno una banda continua de hueso subyacente y los bordes entre los segmentos de estos anillos están cubiertos por placas de blindaje adicionales que ocultan por completo estas conexiones a la vista.

facts.statement: The Saichania skull was wide, measuring 455 mm in length and 480 mm in width in the holotype.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Saichania es ancho, 455 milímetros de largo y 480 milímetros de ancho con el holotipo.

facts.statement: The top of the snout was covered by strongly convex osteoderms.
facts.quote: La parte superior del hocico está cubierta de osteodermos fuertemente convexos.

facts.statement: The squamous horns shaped like pyramids at the back corners of the skull were wide, unlike the narrow ones in Tarchia.
facts.quote: Los cuernos escamosos en forma de pirámide en las esquinas traseras del cráneo son anchos, no estrechos como con Tarchia.

facts.statement: There were large triangular quadratojugal horns on the cheek.
facts.quote: En la mejilla hay grandes cuernos cuadratoyugales triangulares.

facts.statement: The skull had very complex air passages.
facts.quote: El cráneo tenía conductos de aire muy complejos.

facts.statement: Maryańska hypothesized that a recess in the premaxillary sinus housed a Jacobson's organ, a secondary olfactory organ.
facts.quote: Maryańska supuso que este receso albergaba un órgano de Jacobson, un órgano olfativo secundario.

facts.statement: The maxilloturbinal crest was a spiral-shaped bone structure that helps warm-blooded animals condense and preserve exhaled moisture.
facts.quote: Este último era una estructura en forma de volutas, un hueso cornete que sirve con animales de sangre caliente para condensar y preservar la humedad exhalada.

facts.statement: Air passages may have allowed the animal to cool inhaled air and limit water loss.
facts.quote: Los conductos de aire pueden haber permitido al animal enfriar el aire que respiraba y limitar la pérdida de agua.

facts.statement: The hard palate allowed the animal to eat tough plants.
facts.quote: El paladar duro le permitió comer plantas duras.

facts.statement: These features suggested the animal lived in a warm and arid environment.
facts.quote: Todo esto sugería que vivía en un ambiente cálido y árido.

facts.statement: The teeth were small and leaf-shaped.
facts.quote: Los dientes eran pequeños y tenían forma de hoja.

facts.statement: A large hyoid bone apparatus was found, which in 1977 was the most complete discovered for any dinosaur.
facts.quote: Se encontró un gran aparato de hueso hioides, en 1977 el más completo descubierto para cualquier dinosaurio.

facts.statement: This bone apparently supported a long tongue.
facts.quote: Este hueso aparentemente sostenía una lengua larga.

facts.statement: The cervical vertebrae had very long articular processes called zygapophyses, indicating thick intervertebral discs and a longer, more flexible neck than often assumed.
facts.quote: Las vértebras cervicales tienen procesos articulares muy largos, cigapófisis, que muestran que deben haber estado presentes discos intervertebrales gruesos y que el cuello era más largo y más flexible de lo que a menudo se supone.

facts.statement: The short rib and diapophysis of the first dorsal vertebra fused with the coracoid, immobilizing the entire shoulder girdle relative to the spine.
facts.quote: La costilla corta y la diapófisis de la primera vértebra dorsal se fusionan con el coracoides, inmovilizando toda la cintura escapular en relación con la columna vertebral.

facts.statement: From the fifth rib onward, the rib shafts had intercostal plates on their posterior edges, which were ossified cartilage sheets overlapping the front edge of the next rib.
facts.quote: Desde la quinta costilla en adelante, los ejes de las costillas tienen placas intercostales en sus bordes posteriores, láminas de cartílago osificadas, que se superponen al borde frontal de la siguiente costilla.

facts.statement: The breast bones were fully ossified and connected to form a sternum plate that split in the front and branched widely at the back.
facts.quote: Los huesos del pecho están completamente osificados y se conectan para formar una placa esternal que se divide en el frente y se bifurca ampliamente en la parte posterior.

facts.statement: The metacarpus was short, being the shortest among all known Asian ankylosaurs in 1977.
facts.quote: El metacarpo es corto, en 1977 era el más corto de todos los anquilosaurios asiáticos conocidos.

facts.statement: The metacarpals were placed vertically and tightly connected in an arch.
facts.quote: Los metacarpianos se colocaron verticalmente, estrechamente conectados en un arco.

facts.statement: The seams between the neck armor segments were covered by a rectangular area of small oval osteoderms.
facts.quote: Las costuras entre los segmentos están cubiertas por una zona rectangular de pequeños osteodermos ovalados.

facts.statement: A central row of symmetrical conical osteoderms was located on the rear of the animal.
facts.quote: Una fila central de osteodermos cónicos simétricos se coloca en la parte posterior.

facts.statement: Osteoderms were also present on the lower part of the chest.
facts.quote: En la parte inferior del pecho también están presentes los osteodermos.

facts.statement: A 1998 CT scan study by William Gallagher revealed that specimen PIN 3142/250 had a healed puncture wound from a tyrannosaur tooth above its right eye socket.
facts.quote: Un estudio realizado por William Gallagher en 1998 mostró mediante una tomografía computarizada que el espécimen ``PIN 3142/250 tenía un orificio de punción curado de un diente tiranosáurido por encima de la cuenca del ojo derecho.

facts.statement: Researchers suggested that the relative abundance of ankylosaur species in the area was caused by them being the main herbivores, providing enough food for three populations, though their specific ecological niches were unclear.
facts.quote: Asumió que esta abundancia relativa de especies dev anquilosáuridos había sido causada por ser los principales herbívoros en el área, por lo que había suficiente cosecha disponible para alimentar a tres poblaciones, aunque sus nichos relativos no estaban claros.

facts.statement: Differences in head ornamentation likely served for species recognition.
facts.quote: Las diferencias en la ornamentación de la cabeza habrían servido para el reconocimiento de especies.

facts.statement: Maryańska classified Saichania as a member of Ankylosauridae, related to Pinacosaurus, noting that these two dinosaurs differ from all others in the structure of their nasal cavities.
facts.quote: Maryańska clasificó a Saichania como miembro de los Ankylosauridae, emparentados con Pinacosaurus y observó que estos dos dinosaurios difieren de todos los demás en la estructura de sus cavidades nasales.

facts.statement: Later cladistic analyses recovered a position for Saichania in Ankylosaurinae, often near Tarchia.
facts.quote: Los análisis cladísticos posteriores recuperaron una posición en Ankylosaurinae, a menudo cerca de Tarchia

facts.statement: Saichania lived from the Cenomanian to the Campanian stages, between 100.5 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Campanian (100.5 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Saichania belongs to the parent group Ankylosaurinae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Ankylosaurinae

facts.statement: Saichania is classified within the family Ankylosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Ankylosauridae

facts.statement: Saichania belongs to the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: There are 5 recorded fossil occurrences of Saichania in the Paleobiology Database.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 5
